hooks.name: Open data etiquette
hooks.description: After the agent edits a file, checks attribution, API usage limits and honest wording about the data.

action.prompt: If you just changed src/sources.ts or src/App.tsx: keep GBIF lookups behind mapLimit, keep 429 retries, never call Nominatim per keystroke, and keep OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, Wikipedia and GBIF credited in the UI. Never describe a species as extinct or gone for certain; say "no longer recorded". If you changed narration in src/story.ts, the fast-check properties in src/story.test.ts must still pass, including "never contains null, NaN or undefined".
